You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact is one line: subject | relation | value | condition (after "if:", when there is one) | the place it
comes from. A long value or condition is shortened and ends with "…"; a normal form (a date, a duration, a short
name) follows the value in brackets when there is one. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- A fact noted as "filed under a place the question names" belongs to the answer of a "which / what" question
  about that place whenever its relation fits the question: list all of them, not one.
- Lines under "Computed by rule" are results worked out in code from the numbered facts they name: trust them,
  give their result as the answer for the device asked about, and put the fact numbers they name in "used".
- Include only what the question asks for: no neighbouring item, no other regime that the question did not ask
  about. An option that combines several things in sequence is one item, not several.
- A fact about a neighbouring subject (another paragraph, another device, another kind of verification, another
  product, another deadline) does not answer the question. When the exact subject asked about is absent from the
  facts, "unknown" is the correct answer: do not answer from the nearest fact.
- For a "who" question, when one fact, or several facts with the same subject and relation, name several bodies,
  all of them are the answer together: name each one.
- For "which categories / which items listed in a place", the answer is the members filed under that place, each
  in the words of its fact, without adding the place to the item.
- For "which risks / which hazards does a numbered point address", use every fact filed under that point whatever
  its relation: a measure is required against a risk, and its subject and condition name that risk.
- Never return a list for a "text" answer: a question that one sentence answers (who, why, how, under which
  condition, which one thing and why) gets one short sentence. "Which / what / list all" of several things is "set".
- Facts marked "matched by relation" were found by querying the facts by their relation, subject and place:
  prefer them. When the question asks for all of something, the answer is the list of their subjects or values,
  one item per fact, nothing merged and nothing dropped. If the matched facts answer the question, do not add
  items from the other facts, which are context.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: On 1 March 2027, a company that is neither the original manufacturer nor a non-professional user performs a substantial modification to a machine that was placed on the market in February 2027. Under the act in force on that date, as which economic operator is it answerable for the machine?

Facts:
[0] non-professional user modifying machinery for own use | becomes manufacturer | shall not be considered to be a manufacturer | if: for his or her own use | [REG, Art. 18] [matched by relation]
[1] fabbricante ovvero soggetti della catena della distribuzione | has obligation | dall'organo di vigilanza territorialmente competente | if: qualora, alla conclusione dell'accertamento tecnico effettuato dall'autorità nazionale per la sorveglianza del mercato, risulti la non conformità dell'attrezzatura | [DLGS70, art. 70, c. 4]
[2] natural or legal person carrying out substantial modification | has obligation | shall be subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in… | if: if the substantial modification has an impact on the safety of only machinery or a related product that is part of an assembly of… | [REG, Art. 18]
[3] manufacturer, non-professional users | has obligation | provide, in paper format… | if: in the case of machinery intended for non-professional users or that can be used by non-professional users | [REG, Art. 10(7)]
[4] products placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC | placing allowed until | 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) | if: placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC before 20 January 2027 | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 6] [note: 2027-03-01 is 40 days after 2027-01-20]
[5] substantial modification | defined as | a modification of machinery or a related product | if: which is not foreseen or planned by the manufacturer | [REG, Art. 3(16)]
[6] non-professional user modifying machinery for own use | has obligation | shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out… | if: for his or her own use | [REG, Art. 18]
[7] economic operator, products it made available on the market | has obligation | shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken | [REG, Art. 43(3)]
[8] manufacturer or authorised representative | has obligation | must ensure | if: When lifting machinery or lifting accessories are placed on the market or are first put into service | [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.3]
[9] Regulation | applies from | 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) | if: However, the following Articles shall apply from the following dates | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 10] [note: 2027-03-01 is 40 days after 2027-01-20]
[10] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall immediately take the corrective actions necessary | if: Manufacturers who consider or have reason to believe that partly completed machinery which they have placed on the market is not in conformity with… | [REG, Art. 11(9)]
[11] datore di lavoro utilizzatore | has obligation | apposita prescrizione a rimuovere tale situazione | if: nel caso in cui sia stata accertata una contravvenzione | [DLGS70, art. 70, c. 4]
[12] person who carries out substantial modification | has obligation | ensure and declare on its sole responsibility | [REG, Art. 18]
[13] economic operator | has obligation | shall ensure that all appropriate corrective action is taken | if: the products within the scope of this Regulation concerned that the economic operator has made available on the market, throughout the Union | [REG, Art. 45(2)]
[14] relevant economic operator | has obligation | take appropriate and proportionate corrective action | if: the market surveillance authorities find that the product within the scope of this Regulation does not comply with the requirements laid down in this… | [REG, Art. 43(1)]
[15] surfaces in contact with foodstuffs | requires measure | have neither ridges nor crevices | if: other than surfaces of disposable parts | [DIR, Annex I, 2.1.1]
[16] manufacturer | has obligation | perform appropriate tests, or have such tests performed | if: In order to verify that the relevant parts of the machinery or related product comply with the requirements set out in sections 2.4.5.1 and 2.4.5.2… | [REG, Annex III, 2.4.5.3]
[17] distributors | has obligation | act with due care in relation to the requirements of this Regulation | if: When making machinery or a related product available on the market | [REG, Art. 15(1)]
[18] datore di lavoro (punti 1 e 2) | has obligation | si ritengono assolti con la procedura omologativa | if: Per le attrezzature sopra elencate, prive di marcatura CE8 e non oggetto di mo- difiche sostanziali | [inail-guide, p. 35]
[19] manufacturer | has obligation | the limits of the safety functions are to be established as part… | if: where such modifications could lead to hazardous situations | [REG, Annex III, 1.2.1]
[20] relevant economic operator | has obligation | to put an end to the non-compliance concerned | if: where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to machinery or a related product | [REG, Art. 46(1)]
[21] economic operators | has obligation | shall, on request, identify the following to the market surveillance authorities | if: on request | [REG, Art. 19(1)]
[22] relevant economic operator | has obligation | to withdraw that product or to recall it | if: Where, having carried out an evaluation under Article 43(1), a Member State finds | [REG, Art. 45(1)]
[23] relevant economic operator | has obligation | put an end to the non-compliance concerned | if: Without prejudice to Article 43, where a Member State makes one of the following findings with regard to partly completed machinery | [REG, Art. 46(2)]
[24] distributors of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall act with due care | if: When making partly completed machinery available on the market | [REG, Art. 16(1)]
[25] economic operator | defined as | means the manufacturer, the authorised representative | [REG, Art. 3(22)]
[26] relevant economic operator | has obligation | take all appropriate measures | if: Where, having carried out an evaluation under Article 43(1), a Member State finds | [REG, Art. 45(1)]
[27] wording and layout of instructions for use | has obligation | must take into account the level of general education | if: In the case of machinery intended for use by non-professional operators | [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.4.1]
[28] wording and layout of the instructions for use | has obligation | shall take into account the level of general education and acumen | if: In the case of machinery or related products intended for use by non-professional operators | [REG, Annex III, 1.7.4.1]
[29] copy of EU type-examination certificate, annexes, additions and technical documentation kept by manufacturer | retention period | for at least 10 years (P10Y) | if: after the machinery or related product has been placed on the market or put into service | [REG, Annex VII, 7]

[31] importer or distributor | has obligation | subject to the obligations of the manufacturer set out in Articles 10… ("") | if: where that importer or distributor places a product within the scope of this Regulation on the market under its name or trademark or modifies… | [REG, Art. 17]

[33] manufacturer | has obligation | inform users of the residual risks | if: due to any shortcomings of the protective measures adopted | [REG, Annex III, 1.1.2]
[34] importer | has obligation | shall inform the manufacturer and the market surveillance authorities | if: where the machinery or related product presents a risk to the health and safety of persons | [REG, Art. 13(2)]
[35] importers | has obligation | shall immediately take the corrective actions necessary | if: Importers who consider or have reason to believe that machinery or a related product, which they have placed on the market… | [REG, Art. 13(7)]
[36] manufacturers | has obligation | carry out the relevant conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25… | if: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service | [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[37] machinery | must accompany | accompanied by instructions (instructions) | if: in the official Community language or languages of the Member State in which it is placed on the market and/or put into service | [DIR, Annex I, 1.7.4]
[38] manufacturer or authorised representative | has obligation | ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements | if: Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service | [DIR, Art. 5(1)]
[39] manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | shall ensure that the procedure referred to in Article 13 has been… | if: before placing partly completed machinery on the market | [DIR, Art. 5(2)]
[40] importers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | immediately take the corrective actions necessary | if: Importers who consider or have reason to believe that partly completed machinery which they have placed on the market is not in conformity with… | [REG, Art. 14(6)]
[41] distributors | has obligation | the manufacturer and the importer have complied with the requirements | if: Before making machinery or a related product available on the market | [REG, Art. 15(2)]
[42] manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative | has obligation | shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that | if: before placing it on the market | [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[43] manufacturers | has obligation | draw up the technical documentation set out in Annex IV, Part A | if: Before placing machinery or a related product on the market or putting it into service | [REG, Art. 10(2)]
[44] distributor of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall inform the manufacturer or the importer as well as the market… | if: where the partly completed machinery presents a risk as regards relevant essential health and safety requirements | [REG, Art. 16(3)]
[45] impianti di messa a terra | requires check after | variazioni della categoria dell’impianto e la modifica della destinazione d’uso con applicazione… | [inail-guide, p. 15]
[46] datore di lavoro utilizzatore | has obligation | idonea disposizione in ordine alle modalità di uso in sicurezza | if: ove non sia stata accertata una contravvenzione | [DLGS70, art. 70, c. 4]
[47] economic operators: information referred to in paragraph 1 | retention period | at least 10 years (P10Y) | [REG, Art. 19(2)]
[48] manufacturers of partly completed machinery | has obligation | shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed | if: When placing partly completed machinery on the market | [REG, Art. 11(1)]
[49] manufacturer | has obligation | shall cease the placing on the market of the machinery concerned (cease the placing on the market of the machinery concerned) | if: In the event that the validity of the EC-type examination certificate is not renewed | [DIR, Annex IX]
[50] portable cartridge-operated fixing and other impact machinery | placing allowed until | Until 29 June 2011 (2011-06-29) | if: which are in conformity with the national provisions in force upon adoption of this Directive | [DIR, Art. 27] [note: 2027-03-01 is 5724 days after 2011-06-29]
[51] Directive 2006/42/EC | repealed from | 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 5] [note: 2027-03-01 is 40 days after 2027-01-20]
[52] Chapter VI of this Regulation (mutatis mutandis to such products) | applies from | 19 July 2023 (2023-07-19) | if: mutatis mutandis to such products instead of Article 11 of that Directive… | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 7] [note: 2027-03-01 is 1321 days after 2023-07-19]
[53] provisions necessary to comply with this Directive | applies from | 29 December 2009 (2009-12-29) | [DIR, Art. 26(1)] [note: 2027-03-01 is 6271 days after 2009-12-29]
[54] Article 50(1) | applies from | 20 October 2026 (2026-10-20) | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 12] [note: 2027-03-01 is 132 days after 2026-10-20]
[55] Article 6(2) to (6), (8) and (11) and Articles 47 and 53(3) | applies from | 20 July 2024 (2024-07-20) | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 14] [note: 2027-03-01 is 954 days after 2024-07-20]

[59] manufacturer, digital instructions | has obligation | present them in a format that makes it possible for the user… | [REG, Art. 10(7)]

[82] verifiche di cui all’art.71 comma 11 D.Lgs. 81/2008 | verified by | soggetti abilitati | [igea-equipment, p. 4]
[83] aggiudicatario (verificatore): preavviso a IGEA della pianificazione dei controlli | has time limit | 15 giorni (P15D) | [igea-equipment, p. 5]

The matched facts come from both the Directive and the Regulation: use the Regulation's and name that act in the sentence. The other act's facts on the relations asked were left out; today's date does not change which act the question is about.

response.text: {"reasoning": "The date 2027-03-01 is after 2027-01-20, when the Regulation applies (fact 9) and Directive 2006/42/EC is repealed (fact 51). The machine was placed on the market in February 2027, after the 2027-01-20 cut-off for Directive-conforming placing (fact 4), so the Regulation governs it. Under Article 18 of the Regulation, a person other than the original manufacturer or a non-professional user who carries out a substantial modification is subject to the manufacturer's obligations (fact 2) and must ensure compliance and declare it on its sole responsibility (fact 12). Fact 0 concerns non-professional users, which the question excludes. Fact 2's condition is truncated in the record, so the answer keeps its stated scope.","kind": "text","value": "As a manufacturer: under Article 18 of the Regulation, the company is subject to the manufacturer's obligations, and it must ensure compliance and declare it on its sole responsibility, if the substantial modification affects the safety of only machinery or a related product forming part of an assembly.","text": "Under the Regulation (applicable from 20 January 2027), Article 18 makes the company answerable as a manufacturer, subject to the manufacturer's obligations, because it carried out a substantial modification to a machine placed on the market in February 2027.","used": [2, 12, 9, 51, 4]}
